component: Legacy custom-element loader eager and lazy rows

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The legacy table pairs folder-summary and menulist-addrbooks with their scripts and gives scripts defining multiple elements or commonly used elements an empty tag. The empty-tag branch loads immediately; the tagged branch waits for element creation. Keep that distinction when adding a script rather than making the whole table lazy. The dummy extension document is still excluded. Current code keeps this table contract.
title: Lazily load only the one-tag legacy scripts in the loader table
